basis: The charter approved by presidential decree of 8 October 2012 calls the Centre a state institution (dovlet tesisati) that reports directly to the President, who appoints its director, and is financed from the state budget.

basis: The Bangladesh Shilpakala Academy Act 1989 (Act 22), consolidated text on bdlaws read in 2026, section 3(2) makes it a statutory body, section 9(2) has the government appoint the Director-General, section 17 has the Comptroller and Auditor General audit it yearly, and sections 8(2) and 14 require government approval for new departments and property disposals.
